S.FORM: == 西元: == 約1700 ki'an rhzyal 'ringan zyaw事件起因: mhuw sraral lga mqyanux Sbayan Pinsbkan qu Tayal. llingay b'nux ga cyux ki'an Skahmayun kwara. sblaq ta lhga ru pbbiq pngsa ta qoyat qsinuw uzi. ana ga maki' qutux ryax. mrkyas ta mh_yapas squ krakis Skahmayun ru wal pqilun qsuyan na krakis qu mrkyas tayal. pongan krahu kinButa ru syukaw ta muci. yasa musa qmalup ki'an rhzyal nqu Skahmayun. kahul Pinsbkan musa qmalup rrgyax Hagay ru llyung ka ki'an Skahmayun. qinlupan tayal qani krayas sa Slamaw, Qoyaw, Sqabu, Pyanan, Tunan, Gogan si tta ngungu kli ru Sliban. ktan kinButa rhzyal qani ghzi ru blaq baqun maki' ngasal. yasa bzinah mwah Pinsbkan lga, kyalun nya ggluw ru llaqi. usa gmluw sinlayan maku lawi pinshzyan ru bhoyaw mqyanux kya. .Buta討伐時, . zyaw pcingan事件後影響 ita Tayal kahul Pinsbkan musa pinshzyal sa rrgyax te rhzyaq ru llyu qara llyung. mbhoyaw thluyan mqyanux ghzi rhzyal sa hhlahuy te rhzyaq Taywan. Tayal Mknazi泰雅族馬卡納奇族群 Tayal Mlipa 泰雅族馬力巴族群 Skahmayun 史卡馬溫人 mrhuw tgleng領導者 Tayal- Buta krahu 泰雅族-大長老Buta Tayal Mknazi- Ayan, Yabo 泰雅族馬卡納奇- Ayan和Yabo Tayal Mlipa- Bangay, Qbul 泰雅族馬力巴-Bangay和Qbul Skahmayun-Blaq squliq / Yaqih squliq 史卡瑪溫-Blaq和Yaqih
S.PHON: ** ***** kiʔan rħzjal ʔriŋan zjaw**** mħuw [s|ɕ]raral lɣa mqjanux [s|ɕ]βajan pin[s|ɕ]βkan qu tajal lliŋaj βʔnux ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]jux kiʔan [s|ɕ]kaħmajun kwara [s|ɕ]βlaq ta lħɣa ru pββiq pŋ[s|ɕ]a ta qojat q[s|ɕ]inuw uzi ana ɣa makiʔ qutux rjax mrkja[s|ɕ] ta mħəjapa[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu kraki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]kaħmajun ru wal pqilun q[s|ɕ]ujan na kraki[s|ɕ] qu mrkja[s|ɕ] tajal poŋan kraħu kinβuta ru [s|ɕ]jukaw ta mu[ʦ|ʨ]i ja[s|ɕ]a mu[s|ɕ]a qmalup kiʔan rħzjal nqu [s|ɕ]kaħmajun kaħul pin[s|ɕ]βkan mu[s|ɕ]a qmalup rrɣjax ħaɣaj ru lljuŋ ka kiʔan [s|ɕ]kaħmajun qinlupan tajal qani kraja[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]lamaw qojaw [s|ɕ]qaβu pjanan tunan ɣoɣan [s|ɕ]i tta ŋuŋu kli ru [s|ɕ]liβan ktan kinβuta rħzjal qani ɣħzi ru βlaq βaqun makiʔ ŋa[s|ɕ]al ja[s|ɕ]a βzinaħ mwaħ pin[s|ɕ]βkan lɣa kjalun nja ɣɣluw ru llaqi u[s|ɕ]a ɣmluw [s|ɕ]inlajan maku lawi pin[s|ɕ]ħzjan ru βħojaw mqjanux kja βuta*** zjaw p[ʦ|ʨ]iŋan***** ita tajal kaħul pin[s|ɕ]βkan mu[s|ɕ]a pin[s|ɕ]ħzjal [s|ɕ]a rrɣjax te rħzjaq ru llju qara lljuŋ mβħojaw tħlujan mqjanux ɣħzi rħzjal [s|ɕ]a ħħlaħuj te rħzjaq tajwan tajal mknazi********* tajal mlipa ******** [s|ɕ]kaħmajun ***** mrħuw tɣleŋ*** tajal βuta kraħu ******βuta tajal mknazi ajan jaβo ******* ajan*jaβo tajal mlipa βaŋaj qβul ******βaŋaj*qβul [s|ɕ]kaħmajunβlaq [s|ɕ]quliq jaqiħ [s|ɕ]quliq ****βlaq*jaqiħ
